evidence.quote: both always start with an egg and end with an adult insect

reason: Comparing complete and incomplete metamorphosis (both start with an egg, end with an adult insect) is exactly the compare-life-cycles competency of G4-L-5, admitted by the butterfly facet (pattern butterfly|caterpillar|complete metamorphosis matched by 'complete metamorphosis'; the card genuinely teaches the comparison, not just the keyword). TL flag: 'hingkod na insekto' is a garbled phrase for 'adult insect' (BIS 'hamtong nga insekto' is correct) — meaning preserved; flagged for translation repair. Core teaching intact in all three languages.
Bougainvillea living many years with sun and care is plant-care trivia; grow/light/after matches are keyword noise. Potential destination: horticulture enrichment.

Gardeners shaping bougainvillea into bonsai/arches is horticulture; G3-M-8:shaping matches 'shape' but the competency is about changing the shape of solid materials (folding, hammering) — a living plant trained by pruning would misfile. Potential destination: horticulture/materials enrichment.

Boyle's Law (inverse pressure-volume at constant temperature — correct physics) has no authored facet in grades 3-10: G4-E-4:pressure is a weather-element scope and would misfile gas-law content (packet flag grade_mismatch; card cats gases). Potential destination: G10 gas-laws lesson if a facet is authored.

Brahminy kite soaring on rising warm air is flight-adaptation content; warming/advantage/tracking matches are keyword noise (G7-E-9 warming is atmospheric heating scoped). Potential destination: adaptation/thermal-flight enrichment.

Brain fusing two eye images into depth perception is sensory neuroscience; light/comparison matches are keyword noise. Same family as the five-senses-blind-spot hold in batch-30000. Potential destination: senses enrichment.

Brain interpreting signals from eyes/ears/skin/nose/tongue is neuroscience; all matches keyword noise (G5-E-9 'signals' is storm-warning scoped). Potential destination: nervous-system lesson if authored (see wrinkled-folds-g6 hold in 30007).
Brain making sense of sense messages is the same neuroscience family as fact 78; source-receiver and landform matches are noise. Potential destination: nervous-system lesson if authored.
86-billion-neuron statistic is brain trivia; sand/human/rain matches are keyword noise. Potential destination: nervous-system enrichment.
Sternum naming is anatomy vocabulary trivia; left-right/direction matches are noise. Potential destination: human-body enrichment.

Arch bridge redirecting weight into compression is structural engineering; G9-F-3/G10-F-3 'force' facets are Newton's-law competencies — keyword-only credit would misfile. Potential destination: structures/forces lesson if an engineering facet is authored.
Bridge deck distributing load to beams/piers is structural engineering; handling/transfer matches are keyword noise. Same family as the arch-bridge hold. Potential destination: structures enrichment.

Triangle rigidity vs collapsing square is structural-engineering content; G4-F-1:rigid matches 'rigid' but the competency classifies rigid-vs-soft materials by pushing — a shape-strength lesson would misfile. Potential destination: forces/structures lesson if a shape-strength facet is authored.
Broken bones healing over time is body trivia; 'joining' matches the G3-M-8 joining-materials facet — pure keyword noise. Potential destination: human-body enrichment.

evidence.quote: mixing the metals copper and tin

reason: Bronze as an alloy made by mixing the metals copper and tin genuinely teaches copper as a metal and what it is used for — a component of the G3-M-9 community-metals competency (copper facet; analogous to the approved ethers-solvent card in batch-30000 teaching a competency via a named example). Card cats (mixtures) do not block grade 3; no grade-scoped exclusion. TL/BIS faithful (paghahalo ng copper at tin / pagsagol).

Buko as young coconut with soft meat and sweet water is plant-product description; water/grow/Philippin matches are keyword noise (the card teaches no basic-needs, dependency or classification component). Potential destination: useful-plants enrichment.

Buntal hats woven from buri-palm leaf fibers is craft-botany content; uses/plants/care matches are keyword noise — same family as the abaca holds in batch-30007. Potential destination: useful-plants/materials enrichment.

Density sink-float rule (heavier-than-equal-volume-water sinks — correct) has no authored facet: G5-F-5:heavy-and-light matches 'heavier/lighter' but is the gravity weight lesson — consistent with the what-is-buoyancy hold in batch-30007 which refused to misfile buoyancy as basic weight teaching. Potential destination: G5-M-5 or a float-sink lesson if a density facet is authored.

Iron nail sinking because heavier than equal water is the same buoyancy family; iron/magnets/fair-comparison matches are keyword noise. Potential destination: float-sink lesson if a density facet is authored.

Steel ships floating via trapped air lowering average density (correct physics) is the same buoyancy family; all matches keyword noise. Potential destination: float-sink lesson if a density facet is authored.

Bagoong stored in burnay jars keeping food fresh is food-storage culture; storage (microscope), salt (litmus) and burning matches are keyword noise. Potential destination: food-preservation/local-materials enrichment.

Sand mixed into clay to keep burnay jars from cracking is ceramic-craft engineering; G4-E-1 sand/clay facets would misfile pottery material practice as soil-component teaching (the competency describes soil, and the card's sand and clay are pottery materials, not soil samples). Potential destination: materials/ceramics enrichment.

Salt brine stopping spoilage bacteria in burong mangga is food-preservation chemistry; G5-L-4:bacteria matches the bacteria keyword but the classification competency is not taught, and salt facets (litmus, saline) are misfiled. Potential destination: food-preservation enrichment or G10-L-6 if a pickling facet is authored.

Butterfly wing color living in scales that never regrow is wing-structure trivia; G4-L-5:butterfly matches the butterfly keyword only — no life-cycle comparison is taught. Potential destination: insect enrichment.
